beaches.name: Ntana / Gerolimani, Poros
beaches.summary: Occasional nude use is reported at stony beaches near the Ntana headland. The rarely visited beaches lie past Russian Bay; a naturist directory carries reports up to 2015, including nude swimming from visiting yachts, and a 2023 Greek press article names remote beaches at Gerolimena. The directory itself asks for up-to-date reports.
